snippet.title: Spooky Express - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park!

Pick up the creepy cryptids and drop them at their destinations around the park. But be careful! Don’t let them scare or bite the human passengers. Stay on track of the situation or you’ll have a grave problem.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/
